title: FLUX.2 Max joins image generation
summary:
New image, text, and decision models landed alongside sharper CLI usage reports and changes to dashboard measurement.

A Quest contribution added paid-only `black-forest-labs/flux.2-max` for text-to-image generation and editing with up to eight reference images. Its primary route supports custom dimensions, a seed, and PNG output.

A community contribution added `openai/gpt-4o-mini` with image input, tools, and structured outputs. Quest contributions added reasoning models `tencent/hy4-preview` with a million-token context window and `tencent/hy3` with a 262,144-token window. All three are paid-only; regenerated API docs update the model lists.

The team added `typesafe/jev` to Chat Completions. Give it a JSON state and `choice`, `score`, or `noul` questions, and it returns answers with confidence and probabilities. A bring-your-own-key MCP server adds the `jev_decide` tool.

highlights.title: FLUX.2 Max images
highlights.text: Generate images or edit with up to eight reference images using `black-forest-labs/flux.2-max`. The primary route accepts custom dimensions, a seed, and PNG output. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=black-forest-labs/flux.2-max).

highlights.title: GPT-4o Mini added
highlights.text: Use `openai/gpt-4o-mini` for text tasks with tools, structured outputs, and up to ten reference images. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-4o-mini).

highlights.title: Hy4 Preview joins
highlights.text: Try `tencent/hy4-preview` for reasoning, tool use, and structured outputs with a 1,048,576-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=tencent/hy4-preview).

highlights.title: Tencent Hy3 added
highlights.text: Use `tencent/hy3` for reasoning, tools, and structured outputs with a 262,144-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=tencent/hy3).

highlights.title: Jev makes typed decisions
highlights.text: Send `typesafe/jev` a JSON state and `choice`, `score`, or `noul` questions through Chat Completions. Get answers with confidence and probabilities. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=typesafe/jev).

highlights.title: Jev gets an MCP tool
highlights.text: Use the bring-your-own-key Jev MCP server's `jev_decide` tool to request typed decisions from an MCP client. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Inspect CLI usage
highlights.text: Filter `polli usage` history or daily reports by key, model, and a day range of up to 90 days. Inspect token totals or export raw CSV. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).
